# Velair 1.9.3-beta.6

This beta translates the native Mode options and makes Room Assist's control band easier to see. **Existing Mode automations need updating.**

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- **Native Mode selector:** the built-in option values and states are now lowercase. Replace `Default` with `default` and `Manual` with `manual` in select actions, state triggers and conditions, templates, scenes, dashboard comparisons, and external systems when upgrading. This also applies to automations created through Home Assistant's UI. Existing references are not updated automatically. See the [migration guide](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/blob/v1.9.3-beta.6/docs/user/climate-profiles.md#update-existing-mode-automations). ([#80](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/80))
- Keep the existing Mode entity and saved configuration; there is no need to recreate Modes, Profiles, or schedules. Cards that display raw states may show `default` and `manual` instead of translated labels.

## 🔄 Changed

- Home Assistant can display the built-in Mode options in all ten maintained integration languages. Custom Mode names remain exactly as entered. ([#80](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/80))

## 🚀 Improved

- Room Assist's control band has stronger hatching and a subtle tinted background, matched by its legend.

## 🧭 Notes

- This prerelease follows [1.9.3-beta.5](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.3-beta.5).
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app.
